row.evidence: Indeed's employer SSO article lists supported protocols as "SAML and OIDC (SCIM is not supported.)"; SSO is set up through Indeed support after an eligibility check.
row.notes: New in 2026-09. Scored as the Indeed employer account (Indeed for employers). Indeed explicitly says SCIM is not supported for employer SSO; SAML/OIDC SSO is set up with Indeed support after an eligibility check, not tied to a listed plan, so sso_plan is null. Pricing is a per-job Sponsored Job budget (Free, Standard, Premium, Premium Plus beta), so price fields are null. Separately, docs.indeed.com publishes a partner-only SCIM 2.0 API (api.indeed.com/scim/v2/Users, OAuth client credentials, 1-hour tokens) that lets Indeed partners (ATSs, Recruit job boards, Glassdoor) provision users into isolated resource groups for Indeed PLUS integrations; those users never get an Indeed account and cannot sign in to Indeed, so it is not provisioning from a customer IdP and is recorded under fallbacks.other_sync and user_api (partner_only). Okta's OIN 'Indeed' app is SWA only (last updated Mar. 5 2024; checked items read from page markup).

plans.name: Standard (Sponsored Job)
plans.price_text: Budget set per job (Indeed recommends a budget)

limitations.text: Indeed's partner SCIM API (docs.indeed.com) serves Indeed PLUS partner integrations only: partners provision users into resource groups, and those users cannot sign in to Indeed directly. It is not available for a customer IdP to provision Indeed employer accounts.

scim.notes: Employer SSO article says SCIM is not supported. The partner SCIM API is out of scope for scoring (see user_api and fallbacks.other_sync).

endpoints.purpose: Get user details by criteria (returns at most one user)
Hard-delete user and erase identity data

user_api.notes: The only documented user API is the partner-only SCIM 2.0 API for Indeed PLUS integrations (become an Indeed partner; OAuth client-credentials token from Partner Console, expires in 3600 s). Users provisioned there live in partner resource groups, not in a customer's employer account. Delete is a hard delete that prevents reactivation. User schema: userName, externalId, name.givenName, name.familyName, emails (one primary required), phoneNumbers, locale, preferredLanguage, timezone, title, userType, EmployerOrganizations.

okta.notes: OIN 'Indeed' app is SWA only (checked items read from page markup). Indeed's employer SSO (SAML/OIDC) is set up with Indeed support, not via the OIN app.

fallbacks.other_sync: Partner-only SCIM 2.0 API for Indeed PLUS integrations (ATSs, Recruit job boards, Glassdoor) provisioning users into isolated resource groups; not usable by a customer IdP.
fallbacks.notes: Employer users are added and removed by admins (Users and Permissions); SSO 'can also remove access for former employees automatically' and Domain Enforcement limits access to approved domains. Whether SSO creates users on first sign-in (JIT) is not stated.
